scope: 原Q001～Q005阶段、计数和奖励数值承接；新职业物品/剧情适配与任务逐项正式场景引用另需闭合。
initial_pack_owner: 角色初始模板.v1.json; legacy starting_potions=3 is evidence only, never grant in addition to new 5+5 pack

quests.completion: binding completed once; unlock Q002; no rank/skill grants

quests.objective: deliver 3 real linglong bamboo items to Cao

quests.boss_kill_reward: separate explicitly mapped monster reward, never silently add quest XP

counters.start: after Q003 final delivery, valley_boar/frost_wolf each increments own lifetime journey counter
counters.shared_party_kills: not adopted here; task config explicitly requires participant kill credit; no implicit all-room sharing
counters.deduplication: authoritative death event per character/counter; no overkill second kill

repeat_rule: claim next round only when lifetime counter >= (claimed_rounds+1)*5; no kill counter reset or implicit daily refresh; mainline same 5 kills can cover first repeat as old code does; one explicit claim one round

sword_migration.legacy_behavior: TakeSword overwrites weapon slot; forbidden for new multi-class templates
sword_migration.new_grant: one unique story sword instance into equipment bag; never overwrites initial weapon
sword_migration.class_equipping: sword-class compatible use explicit equip transaction only; other classes keep story sword as quest artifact and use their own weapon for combat/gathering
sword_migration.duplicate_grant: stage/request guard; import preserves existing instance and does not grant again
sword_migration.formal_item_definition_status: 剧情剑与玲珑竹.v1.json defines ownership/stats/permissions and all3 explicit enhancement recipes; legacy instance mapping still pending

transactions: step/real items/XP/silver/potions/claimed round counters and result IDs commit once; validate output capacity after input removal; insufficient space retains deliverable state; save failure re-saves same committed result
rule_changes: new gameplay XP uses explicit180 table, level-up never refills resources; initial potion/new class rules override old starting3 grant only for new roles; original rewards retained as starter quest rewards not high-level economy proof
open_dependencies: full old save story-stage mapping without resource loss
